history.title: This e-bike fits seven riders, and that’s not even the craziest thing about it
history.summary: If you’ve ever looked at a cargo e-bike and thought, “Sure, but where am I supposed to put the other six people?”, SixThreeZero may finally have the answer. The company’s latest addition to its growing e-bike and e-trike lineup, the Long Range Luxury Rickshaw , is already a fairly ridiculous machine in its standard form. It combines three wheels, dual motors, rear passenger seating bench, and enough battery capacity to make many electric motorcycles jealous. But start adding its optional passenger trailers, and you can essentially build yourself a seven-person electric bicycle train. more…

In reality, though, most of them spend their lives on city streets, bike paths, and neighborhood roads. That’s what makes the Batch Bicycles eFT.3 refreshing.
